hero.statement: PrimeDesk started in Houston in 2025 to close a simple gap: small businesses need a full marketing team, but can't hire one. So we became one. Strategy, content, ads, SEO, web, and support from one group that works inside your business, day to day.

stats.label: Minimum partnership, so the work compounds

founder.name: Fareed Huda
founder.description: PrimeDesk started in Houston to give small businesses a marketing team that can work alongside them day to day.
founder.draftQuote: I wanted small businesses to have a marketing team that learns how they work, takes ownership, and makes the next step clear.

different.heading: What makes us
different.description: We’re built for small businesses that want a real marketing team without hiring one.

items.title: Embedded, not outsourced.
items.description: We work as part of your team. We learn your goals and priorities before we produce anything.

items.title: Built for small businesses.
items.description: We take on research, strategy, execution, and content. Your team focuses on direction, reviews, and feedback.

items.title: Nimble.
items.description: When your priorities change, we adjust without rebuilding the scope.

items.title: Global coverage.
items.description: Our team spans four countries and multiple time zones, so work moves while you’re offline.

items.title: Committed to results.
